nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Entry point of the shared UI style system: declares the cascade layer order (theme, base, components, utilities) and aggregates the entire stylesheet via layered @imports — color ramps and semantic theme tokens into theme, the preflight reset into base, ~54 per-component stylesheets from ../components/ into components, and utilities plus animations into utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses native CSS cascade layers (@layer + @import ... layer(...)) so component styles always win over tokens and lose to utilities, independent of import order.

nodes.name: animations.css
nodes.summary: Defines the shared keyframe library (pulse-opacity, pulse-scale, pulse-opacity-dim, fadeUp) and exposes --animate-pulse tokens on :root, plus the .fade-up-text class whose nth-child(1..30) selectors stagger the fade-up animation in 0.1s steps for cascading list entrances.
nodes.languageNotes: The --animate-* custom properties are later re-registered as Tailwind animate tokens via the @theme block in tailwind/index.css; the 30-rule nth-child ladder is pure repetition to delay up to 30 siblings.

nodes.name: base.css
nodes.summary: Global preflight/reset for the UI package: border-box sizing, margin/padding/border resets, font inheritance for form controls and mono elements, replaced-element display fixes, and hidden-attribute enforcement, extended with Tauri drag-region rules and a touch-device media query that forces 16px inputs to prevent iOS focus zoom.
nodes.languageNotes: Closely mirrors Tailwind Preflight (down to issue-linked comments) but adds project-specific rules: app-region drag/no-drag for Tauri windows and an iOS anti-zoom font-size guard for coarse pointers.

nodes.name: colors.css
nodes.summary: The raw color-token registry: 12-step scales with solid and alpha variants for ~14 palette families (gray, smoke, yuzu, cobalt, apple, ember, solaris, lilac, coral, mint, blue, ink, amber), closed by a legacy-alias section that keeps older themes working (smoke→gray, amber-lightalpha→amber-light-alpha, purple-9→lilac-9, cyan-9→blue-9).
nodes.languageNotes: Radix-style 12-step ramps where each step has a fixed semantic role (1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 components, 6-8 borders, 9-10 solid fills, 11-12 text); alpha is encoded as 8-digit hex. The gray ramp is declared twice — the later warm-tinted block silently overrides the initial neutral one — and the trailing alias block intentionally re-points legacy names at the new values.

nodes.name: theme.css
nodes.summary: The semantic design-token layer: typography, spacing, breakpoints, container widths, radii, and layered box shadows, followed by the complete 'OC-2 fallback' semantic palette (background, surface, text, input, button, border, icon, syntax-highlighting, markdown, diff, avatar colors) declared in light mode with a nested prefers-color-scheme: dark override that redefines every variable.
nodes.languageNotes: Dual-scheme theming via a @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block nested inside :root, so dark mode needs no class toggling; shadows use light-dark() with var() fallbacks, and specialized tokens like --icon-agent-plan/ask/build-base color per-agent-type icons.

nodes.name: utilities.css
nodes.summary: Global helper classes: .no-scrollbar, .sr-only, .truncate-start (RTL direction trick to ellipsize the start of overflowing text), a pointer-events fix for floating-ui popper positioners, and the .text-12-regular through .text-20-medium typography scale composed entirely from theme.css font variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Only consumes tokens (var(--font-*), var(--line-height-*)) defined in theme.css, keeping this file theme-agnostic; truncate-start uses direction: rtl so the ellipsis lands at the logical start of the text.
